title: Performance Optimization & Scalability — Failure Injection & Auto-Healing
purpose: Simulates Cloud Bigtable Key Hotspotting & Automated Tablet Rebalancing: illustrates detection of monotonically increasing row keys and key visualizer remediation.
routing_rationale: Monotonically increasing row keys (like sequential timestamps) cause all write traffic to pile onto a single tablet server; salting or reversing keys distributes load evenly across all nodes.

nodes.label: 100k IoT Devices
nodes.detail: All 100,000 devices send metrics with current timestamp prefix: 2026-09-24T12:00:01#dev1.

nodes.label: Bigtable Key Visualizer
nodes.detail: Reveals intense bright red horizontal stripe indicating write hotspotting on single tablet.

nodes.label: Tablet Node 1 (CPU 100%)
nodes.detail: Receives 100% of write traffic; write latency spikes from 3ms to 4,500ms.

nodes.label: Salted Hash Key Distribution
nodes.detail: Distributes writes evenly across all 16 tablet nodes; cluster CPU drops to 22%.

steps.title: Hotspotting Saturation
steps.action: Sequential timestamp keys funnel all writes to one tablet; Key Visualizer reveals severe hotspot.
steps.why_traversal: Visualizes the most common Bigtable anti-pattern.

steps.title: Key Salting & Even Distribution
steps.action: Application switches row key prefix to hash(device_id); writes scatter across all tablets.
steps.why_traversal: Restores single-digit millisecond write performance across millions of QPS.

scenarios.label: Tablet Server Thrashing
scenarios.root_cause: Application persisted sequential keys without salting during sudden IoT telemetry surge.
scenarios.diverted_path: Writes fail with DEADLINE_EXCEEDED; IoT gateway buffers overflow.
scenarios.recovery: Pre-split Bigtable tables and salt row keys with murmur3 hash prefixes.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted

scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
